北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷体感 5℃，出门记得添衣保暖哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is chilly at 5℃. Remember to dress warmly when you go out.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴冷体感 4℃，湿冷侵袭，多穿点才暖和。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is damp and cold, feels like 4℃. Bundle up to stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 5℃，微风吹拂，注意添衣防寒。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is partly cloudy, feels like 5℃. With a light breeze, remember to dress warmly.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天 18℃，体感舒适，但湿度高，注意防潮哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast at 18℃, feels comfortable. High humidity, remember to stay dry.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天 20℃，体感暖和，湿度大，记得带伞。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast at 20℃, feels warm. High humidity, remember your umbrella.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 6℃，风有点凉，记得多穿件外套。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast, feels like 6℃. The wind is a bit chilly, remember an extra jacket.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴好，体感 7℃，阳光正好，出去走走也很棒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and clear, feels like 7℃. Perfect for a walk outside!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云 18℃，体感宜人，记得享受美好时光。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is partly cloudy at 18℃, feels pleasant. Enjoy the lovely weather!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云体感 10℃，湿气重，注意保暖别着凉。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is partly cloudy, feels like 10℃. High humidity, stay warm and don't catch a cold.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴天，体感 7℃，微风不燥，穿暖出门晒晒太阳。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like 7℃. Gentle breeze, dress warmly and enjoy the sun.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云体感 14℃，湿度高，早晚温差大，注意调整着装。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is partly cloudy at 14℃, high humidity. Mind the temperature changes, dress accordingly.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗但体感-7℃，滴水成冰，务必把自己裹严实。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels like -7℃. Extremely cold, make sure to bundle up tightly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云体感-4℃，寒意十足，出门多穿几层哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is partly cloudy, feels like -4℃. It's quite cold, layer up when you go out!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 3℃，风力稍大，出门记得戴围巾。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is partly cloudy, feels like 3℃. Wind is a bit strong, remember your scarf!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感 8℃，风力不小，海边更凉，注意保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast, feels like 8℃. Strong winds, especially by the sea. Stay warm!
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 0℃，海风凛冽，防寒保暖不能少。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like 0℃. The sea breeze is biting, make sure to keep warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗但体感-3℃，阵阵寒意，记得多加衣物。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but feels like -3℃. A chilly feeling, remember to add more layers.
